themes.consensus_view: Four major banks flag the Jackson Hole central bank meeting as the near-term event to watch for signals on interest rate policy, but none has staked out a directional call on what it will deliver.

facts_agreed.claim: Banks across four desks reference the Jackson Hole symposium as an upcoming policy event in this window without taking a side on the outcome.
The keynote speech is the specific part of the event desks are pointing to, with Goldman naming Warsh as the speaker.
evidence_quotes: Jackson Hole symposium with Warsh speaking
Jackson Hole Roadmap keynote by Chairman Warsh

themes.consensus_view: Gold has run to about $4,600 an ounce and the desks covering it agree the price is now swinging harder in both directions as heavy call-option buying amplifies every move, with UBS still targeting $5,400 over the next year.

facts_agreed.claim: Heavy demand for call options on gold is amplifying the size of price moves in both directions, not just to the upside.
evidence_quotes: creating a mechanical price amplifier to both the upside and downside

facts_agreed.claim: Gold is trading near $4,600 an ounce after a sharp August advance, and both desks mark the same level.

themes.consensus_view: Banks agree that demand for AI computing power is still running ahead of what suppliers can deliver and is now pulling through into power, copper and chip-making spending, but they disagree on whether the companies building it can raise all the money they have committed to spend.

facts_agreed.claim: Demand for AI computing capacity continues to exceed available supply, and contract activity backs that up.
evidence_quotes: Demand for compute remains robust and continues to exceed available supply.
Management characterised demand as exceptionally strong, reflected in four landmark billion-dollar contracts

facts_agreed.claim: AI is a durable driver of earnings and investment over a multi-year horizon.
evidence_quotes: We have strong conviction in the long-term potential gains offered by AI.

facts_agreed.claim: AI spending is feeding through into physical commodity demand, with copper the clearest channel.
evidence_quotes: AI-related investment ultimately translates into expectations for higher physical copper demand

facts_contested.claim: whether the debt needed to fund the AI buildout is a real risk to the companies building it
facts_contested.for_evidence: If you assign any probability that companies ultimately cannot finance everything they intend to build
facts_contested.against_evidence: We have strong conviction in the long-term potential gains offered by AI.

themes.consensus_view: Three banks keep pointing at possible disruption to oil shipping through the Strait of Hormuz as a live risk this window, but none has committed to a call on which way prices go from here.

facts_agreed.claim: Three banks flag the Strait of Hormuz as an open shipping and oil supply risk tied to the US-Iran conflict.
evidence_quotes: US-Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz shipping
Strait of Hormuz oil supply tensions

facts_agreed.claim: UBS returns to the Strait across several notes, treating it as an ongoing conflict and a shipping-restriction risk rather than a settled event.

themes.consensus_view: Three desks reference US sanctions and economic pressure on Iran as an active backdrop this window, but none has taken a directional position on how it resolves or what it does to markets.

facts_agreed.claim: JPMorgan, UBS and Goldman Sachs all flag US economic sanctions and financial pressure on Iran as a live backdrop in this window without arguing a market direction from it.
evidence_quotes: US Treasury economic sanctions on Iran
